## 🌐 Tool: list_managed_sites
Melihat daftar seluruh website WordPress yang sedang dikelola dan status index/GSC-nya.

parameters.query:
SELECT s.slug, s.name, s.domain, s.wp_base_url, s.gsc_property, s.is_active,
       COUNT(p.url)::int AS indexed_pages,
       to_char(MAX(p.indexed_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS last_indexed
FROM seo_sites s
LEFT JOIN seo_pages p ON p.site_slug = s.slug
GROUP BY s.slug, s.name, s.domain, s.wp_base_url, s.gsc_property, s.is_active
ORDER BY s.created_at ASC;
